description: The number of partitions of n into distinct positive parts. This equals the number of partitions into odd parts. q(0) is 1 and q(5) is 3. n runs from 0 to 2000. An optional modulus reduces the count; zero is rejected. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/partition-distinct
